# Ever-Deeper v0.44.0-dev.2 — coherent surface

The previous surface drew colored road outlines, duplicated terrain banks and a cropped floating portal crown. Its small copper pile did not match the approved elevated forest composition.

This candidate replaces the Mossvein road presentation with an authored earth-and-cliff shelf, registered to the actual route. The road curves through the new complete Moonglass arch and joins a matching cyan Moonglass shelf. Rear and foreground pillar layers share one genuinely transparent PNG; pillar footprints are solid and the existing gate unlock/opening/crossing state machine remains responsible for passage. The old full-height boundary crop and floating crown are removed at this transition.

A taller copper mountain has four separately authored, registered damage stages. Its collision ellipse and mining target share the new footprint; 360 HP, 24 copper yield, equipment multipliers and 150-second regrowth remain. A premultiplied single-pass blend preserves solid mountain coverage between damage stages. Forge is moved clear of the taller mountain. The mine entrance stays on its separate lower branch. The surface camera zoom is 0.86; cave camera rigs retain their existing settings. The approved native hero and all equipment are retained.

## Validation

Source and packaged Godot suites verify the locked gate, open traversal in both directions, solid pillar feet, the 24-copper cycle, full regrowth, both directions on the lower branch, shop access and setup of all 25 visual states. Their success does not constitute visual acceptance.

Final mobile Web evidence must be inspected at 932×430 before release: start and shops; full, damaged, empty and regrowing mountain; branch, entrance and return; gate locked, opening, open and both crossing directions; the Moonglass join; later surface roads. Chromium/SwiftShader captures are not a physical iPhone performance measurement.

Assets were created with the built-in image generator from the approved concept as a style guide. The approved PNG gate was cleaned with expressly authorized Python. The same boundary-connected alpha extraction was used where new production assets contained painted checkerboards. Original generated images and preparation scripts are preserved in the work archive. No concept crops are used as production assets.

Publication status, exact candidate hashes and visual acceptance are recorded in the companion evidence archive and current handoff.
